title: Tune your assistant
goal: Improve your saved assistant by editing its rules — fix what it gets wrong without starting over.

blocks.title: Edit the rules, don't restart
blocks.body:
You've used your assistant a few times, and one thing keeps bugging you — maybe the quiz questions come out too hard, or the feedback sounds stiff.

Don't scrap it and start over. An assistant improves the way a good routine does: you edit its rules. Add one line, and it fixes that every time from now on:
• "Always include an answer key."
• "Keep questions at Class 6 level."
• "Never use $ — use ₹."
• "Give one warm sentence before any correction."

Small rule, permanent fix.

blocks.question: Your quiz-maker assistant keeps producing questions that are too hard for your class. What's the best way to tune it?

options.text: Start a fresh chat and rewrite the whole assistant from scratch
Add one rule: "Keep every question at Class 6 level — simple wording, one step to solve"
Just type "make it better" each time you use it

blocks.explanation: Editing one rule fixes the problem for every future use — that's the whole power of a saved assistant. Starting over throws away what already worked, and "make it better" only fixes it this once. You're maintaining a tool now, colleague.

blocks.scaffold: Here's my saved assistant. Add one rule to fix a failure I keep seeing — for example "Always keep questions at {{gradeBand}} level" or "Always add an answer key". Keep everything else exactly the same, then show me the updated assistant so I can re-save it.

blocks.question: How confident do you feel maintaining your own AI helper — tuning its rules as you go?
